rationale: ZeRO3 omits frozen params from checkpoint; detected by comparing module.named_parameters() set vs saved keys at load (anti-example 7). Borderline P7 vs P8: chose P7 because the check fires only when an actual save/load runs (state-counter on saved-key set), not a pure build-time assertion. parallel_dim=DP because ZeRO3 shards along DP.
